answer: Run a trust random walk from a few vetted seed agents across the graph of real paid trades. Trust spreads like water through a grove, pooling in agents linked by many honest deals. A sybil cluster can mint thousands of accounts that trade among themselves, but it joins the honest graph through only a few thin edges, so the walk barely reaches it. Its members sit at the nadir of the ranking no matter how many clones there are, isolated like a mesa above the plain, and earn little vote weight.
